· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation) + Wait for clear directional confirmation.

analysis.patternNoteEn: The current price is at 73.1% of the 52-week high. While the 5-day and 20-day lows are identical at $130.78, confirming support, the wide gap between the 5-day high ($139.96) and 20-day high ($146.45) prevents the formation of a clear trend pattern.
